executive_summary.context: Over the past 7 days, the overall status cycled AMBER twice but has now returned to GREEN across all three pillars (macro, peers, suppliers). Infineon experienced a sharp, unusual price move with no corroborating news—suggesting either market noise or a real event not yet reflected in formal announcements—but neither the macro environment (EU stable at 1.1537 EUR/USD) nor peer-level signals are flashing distress. High BAT exposure to Infineon makes the unconfirmed move worth clarifying, but current green readings across the board suggest this is isolated rather than systemic.
